monitor_rules: Compare durable reference progress and finalized queue reduction, separating new readings, reuse, unknown, isolation and unprocessed status. Check saved checkpoints once before calling unchanged public metadata a stall.

After two consecutive eligible hourly observations with neither durable new references nor progress toward the next required deliverable, flag suspected stall and identify one concrete cause. Quota/network/auth/source/Slurm blockers are reported separately.
Alert on unauthorized sample, taxonomy, scope, completion-definition or model/channel changes; no broad historical rereview.

Alert on rereading completed judgments, repeating an already-exhausted source recovery, or repeated cosmetic work that prevents production. Necessary exact-quote corrections and context handoffs alone are not loops.
At processable queue closure, advance to the already-approved single final fit/evaluation and field decision. Do not substitute new development, model search or holdout reselection.

Never equate Formal800 completion with fixed10k completion, predictions with reference labels, presence with full semantics, validator success with semantic accuracy, or A closure with full-corpus research completion.
root_decisions: Reject a blanket stop after two formatting fixes or two metadata-only commits: those counts alone do not establish unproductive repetition. Require unchanged durable progress plus concrete evidence.
